title: DO THIS FOR [ 30 MINUTES ] EVERY MORNING YOU WAKE UP AND 7 THINGS WILL HAPPEN
text: Hallelujah. Glory to God. There is a stirring in the realm of the spirit even as you are connecting right now. I want you to know that this is not ordinary. This is not a coincidence. Heaven has orchestrated this moment for you. Some of you woke up earlier than usual. Some of you could not sleep. Some of you felt a restlessness in your spirit and you did not know what it was. The Holy Ghost was preparing you for this encounter. Before we go any further, I want you to do something for me. Share this broadcast right now. Send it to someone. Post it. Let the Lord use you as an instrument to change a life today. There is somebody, maybe a family member, maybe a friend, maybe someone you have not spoken to in years that needs this word. Do not keep it to yourself. Be a vessel of blessing. The anointing that will flow through this service will touch lives, but you must be the carrier. Share this now. Glory to God. Can we just worship him for a moment. You are Yahweh. You are Yahweh. There is no one like you, Lord. There is no one like you. We give you praise. We give you praise. [music] We give you glory. We give you honor. You are the God who does wonders. You declared your strength among the people. You have with your arm redeemed your children. The children of Jacob and Joseph. We worship you this morning, Lord. We bow before your throne. Every knee shall bow. Every tongue shall confess that you are Lord. You are Lord. Blessed be your name. Blessed be your name, the name above all names, the name that causes demons to tremble, the name that opens prison doors, the name that breaks every chain. Jesus. Jesus. Jesus. There is power in that name. There is healing in that name. There is deliverance in that name. There is breakthrough in that name. We worship you Yahweh. We worship you Elohim. We worship you Adonai. We worship you El Shaddai. You are the Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. You are the King of glory, the Lord of hosts. Kabiyesi. >> [music] >> Kabiyesi. We bow before you. We honor you. We reverence you. Let your presence fill this place. Let your glory saturate this atmosphere. Let your power move among your people. Let your fire fall upon every heart. We receive you, Lord. We welcome you, Holy Spirit. Have your way. Have your way. Have your way in this place. Glory to God. Thank you, Lord. Thank you, Holy Spirit. There is an atmosphere here. Can you feel it? There is a weight of glory. Something is about to happen. Something is about to shift. Something is about to break. I can sense it in my spirit. The presence of the Lord is here, not as a formality, not as a religious ritual, but as a living reality. Sit down if you are standing. I need your attention. I need you present, not just physically, but spiritually. Whatever is trying to distract you right now, bind it. Whatever is trying to pull your attention away from this moment, rebuke it. This is your hour. This is your moment. This is your season of encounter. Now, listen carefully to me. The title of this ministration is let my adversaries be scattered. And I want you to understand something from the very beginning. This is not just a prayer. This is a prophetic decree. This is a spiritual instruction. This is a divine mandate that we are releasing into the atmosphere this morning. Open your Bible with me to Psalm 68 verses 1 through 3. Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before [music] him. As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melted before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God. But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yea, let them exceedingly rejoice. Did you hear that? Let God arise. When God arises, his [music] enemies scatter. When God shows up, opposition flees. When God manifests his presence, wickedness melts like wax before fire. I want to prophesy over your life this morning. [music] Every adversary that has positioned itself against your destiny, [music] as God arises in this service, they shall scatter. They shall scatter. They shall [music] scatter. Somebody shout, "Let my adversaries be scattered." Say it again with fire. LET MY ADVERSARIES BE SCATTERED. NOW, let me teach you something before we pray. There are dimensions to this matter. Not every attack is obvious. Not every adversary is visible. Not every opposition is physical. The Bible tells us in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Your adversary might have a human face, but behind that face is a spirit. Your adversary might operate through systems, but behind those systems are principalities. Your adversary might manifest through circumstances, but behind those circumstances is a coordinated effort of hell to stop your destiny. Listen to me. The enemy does not attack everybody. He is strategic. He targets carriers of destiny. He targets vessels of purpose. Listen to me. The enemy does not attack everybody. He is strategic. He targets carriers of destiny. He targets vessels of purpose. He targets people who have been marked for impact. If hell is fighting you, it is a sign that heaven has a plan for you. If the enemy is resisting you, it is evidence that you carry something that threatens his kingdom. Some of you have been wondering, "Why me? Why is my life like this? Why does it seem like things that work for others do not work for me? Why does it seem like there is an invisible hand holding me back?" I have come to tell you this morning, it is not a mistake. It is not a coincidence. It is not your imagination. There is an adversary. But here is the good news, there is also a God. And when God arises, adversaries scatter. Turn with me to Numbers 10:35. And it came to pass when the ark set forward that Moses said, "Rise up, Lord, and let thine enemies be scattered, and let them that hate thee flee before thee." This was the cry of Moses every time the ark of the covenant began to move. The ark represented the presence of God, and Moses understood that as the presence moved, enemies had to scatter. I prophesy over your life this morning. As you connect with the presence of God in this service, EVERY ENEMY THAT HAS POSITIONED itself on the pathway of your destiny SHALL SCATTER. EVERY FORCE THAT HAS MOUNTED ITSELF AS a blockade to your breakthrough shall be dismantled. EVERY POWER THAT HAS SWORN THAT YOU WILL not advance SHALL BE CONSUMED BY FIRE. Let me tell you something about adversaries. There are different categories. The first category is human adversaries. These are people who have set themselves against you, either openly or secretly. They could be enemies you know or enemies you do not know. They could be enemies outside your circle or enemies within your circle. The Bible says in Psalm 41 verses 9, "Yea, mine own familiar friend in whom I trusted which did eat of my bread have lifted up his heel against me." Sometimes your adversary shares your table. Sometimes your adversary knows your secrets. Sometimes your adversary has access to your life that you have given them, but I decree this morning, whether they are far or near, whether they are known or unknown, let them be scattered. [music] The second category is demonic adversaries. These are spirits that have been assigned against you. Spirits of delay, spirits of stagnation, spirits of poverty, spirits of sickness, spirits of confusion, spirits of error, spirits of death. The Bible tells us in 1 Peter 5 verses 8, "Be sober, be vigilant because your adversary the devil as a roaring lion walketh about seeking whom he may devour." Notice that scripture, "Your adversary the devil." The devil is not just an idea, he's not just a symbol of evil, he is a real personality with a real agenda, and his agenda is to devour, to devour your health, to devour your marriage, to devour your finances, to devour your destiny, to devour your children, to devour your future, but I have a word for you this morning. The devourer is rebuked. By the authority in the name of Jesus Christ, I rebuke every devouring spirit that has been assigned against your life. You shall not devour, you shall not consume, you shall not destroy. The third category is systemic adversaries. These are systems, structures, and institutions that have been weaponized against the children of God. Systems of injustice, systems of oppression, systems of limitation. Some of you have been qualified for opportunities, but the system keeps passing you over. Some of you have worked harder than everyone else, but the system keeps ignoring you. Some of you have submitted applications, proposals, [music] and requests, but the system keeps rejecting you. I prophesy over your life, every system that has been weaponized against your advancement, I COMMAND DIVINE DISRUPTION. I command supernatural intervention. I command angelic infiltration. THE SYSTEM SHALL work in YOUR FAVOR. THE SYSTEM SHALL BOW TO THE PURPOSE of God upon your life. The fourth category is ancestral adversaries. These are battles that have been inherited. These are wars that started before you were born. These are patterns that have repeated themselves in your family line. Patterns of early death, patterns of marital failure, patterns of financial collapse, patterns of mental illness, patterns of barrenness, patterns of addiction. [music] Listen to me, you did not start some of the battles you are fighting. They were handed to you. They came with your name. They came with your bloodline. But, here is a revelation. Jesus shed his blood to break every bloodline curse. The blood of Jesus is superior to the blood of your ancestors. The covenant of the cross supersedes the covenants of your forefathers. I decree over your life every ancestral adversary, every generational pattern, every inherited curse, every familiar spirit that has followed YOUR FAMILY LINE, BY THE BLOOD OF JESUS CHRIST, I command you to release your hold. Your dominion is over. Your assignment is terminated. Let there be scattering. Are you following me? Can you sense what the spirit is doing? There is a setting up happening in the realm of the spirit. There is a positioning happening. There is an alignment happening. Stay focused. Stay connected. Stay in the spirit. Now, I want to take you to another scripture. Turn with me to Isaiah 54:15-17. "Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me. Whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake. Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work. And I have created the waster to destroy. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord." Did you hear what the Lord said? "They shall surely gather together." The gathering is certain. The attack is inevitable. The opposition is guaranteed. But, and here is the key, but not by me. It is not God who gathered them. It is not God who orchestrated the attack. It is not God who sent the adversary. And because God did not gather them, they shall fall. Whoever has gathered against you shall fall for your sake. Not for their sake, for your sake. Your battle is written in your favor. Your war has a predetermined outcome. Your victory is already written in heaven. I speak over everyone connected to this service. Whoever has gathered against you in secret meetings, in covens, in boardrooms, in family meetings, in conspiracy, because they gathered without divine authorization, they shall fall. THEY SHALL FALL. THEY SHALL FALL. LISTEN, the devil does not attack you because you are weak. He attacks you because you are dangerous. He attacks you because you carry something. He attacks you because your future threatens his kingdom. He attacks you because your children will be world changers. He attacks you because your ministry will set CAPTIVES FREE. HE ATTACKS YOU BECAUSE your business will fund the gospel. HE ATTACKS YOU BECAUSE YOUR MARRIAGE WILL BE A testimony of God's faithfulness. But here is what the enemy did not calculate. He did not calculate that the same God who created you would arise on your behalf. He did not calculate that the lion of the tribe of Judah would roar over your situation. He did not calculate that the blood of Jesus would speak for you. He did NOT CALCULATE THAT THIS morning you would connect with a word that would shift everything. The scattering begins now. Say it with me, the scattering [music] begins now. Again, the scattering begins now. With fire, THE SCATTERING begins now. Hallelujah. >> [music] >> Before we enter full warfare, I want to release some prophetic words. [music] Someone needs to hear this. There is someone here the Lord is showing me. You have been experiencing strange setbacks. Every time you are about to move forward, something pulls you back. Every time you are about to celebrate, something goes wrong. Every time you are about to testify, something happens. The Lord says to tell you there is a spirit of the tail operating in your life. It has been assigned to keep you at the back when you should be at the front. But the Lord says today is your day of deliverance. That spirit is broken. You will no longer be the tail. You will be the head. YOU WILL NO LONGER BE BENEATH. You will be above. THE CYCLE OF ALMOST but never is broken in your life right now. There is another person the Lord is showing me. You have been having strange dreams, dreams of being attacked, dreams of being chased, dreams of eating in the dream, dreams of sleeping with strange people, dreams of seeing yourself in your old house, in your old village, in your old school. The Lord says these are not ordinary dreams. These are spiritual attacks, but I come with fire this morning. I decree over your life every evil plantation that has been deposited in your dream life, I command fire, LET IT BURN. EVERY MONITORING spirit that has been watching you in the dream, I command blindness, you cannot see anymore. Every covenant that was initiated in the dream, I command termination. By the blood of Jesus, you are free. Someone here, the number seven keeps appearing. Maybe you have been married for seven years without a child. Maybe every seven years something bad happens. Maybe you are 27 or 37 or 47 and you feel stuck. The Lord says there is a pattern connected [music and singing] to that number in your bloodline, but today the cycle breaks. The number seven will no longer represent [music] a cause. It will represent completion. It will represent perfection. It will represent divine fullness. The pattern is broken. >> [music] >> There is a woman here the Lord is showing me. You have been bleeding financially. Money comes in and disappears. You work hard, but there is nothing to show for it. [music] The Lord says there is a spirit of the leaking bag operating against you, but I come with a word of restoration. I decree [music] over your finances. Every hole in your bag is sealed. Every leakage is [music] blocked. Every defiler is rebuked. You will begin to accumulate. You will begin to multiply. You will begin to have more than enough. There is a man here. I see someone in business. Your business partner has betrayed you. They have taken what belongs to you. They have lied about you. They have sabotaged you. The Lord says do not despair. What stolen they will return. What they have taken it will come back to you and God will raise up new partners, covenant partners, faithful partners, partners who will build with you and not destroy. Hold on. Your restoration is coming. Someone is dealing with a health challenge. The doctors have given you a report. They have named it. They have given you a timeline. But I have a word from the Lord. Doctors report what they see, but God speaks what he wills. And God says concerning your body, I will restore health onto you. I will heal you of your wounds. That sickness is not onto death. It is for the glory of God. You will live and not die. You will declare the works of the Lord in the land of the living. I feel the fire of the Holy Ghost. I feel the anointing rising. I feel something shifting in the atmosphere. We are about to pray now, but this is not ordinary prayer. This is warfare. This is engagement. This is prophetic violence in the realm of the spirit. The Bible says in Matthew 11:12, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence and the violent take it by force." This is not the time for gentle prayer. This This not the time for timid intercession. This is the time for spiritual violence. This is the time to contend with fire. This is the time to enforce the victory of Calvary. This is the time to make a demand upon the finished work of Jesus Christ. Every adversary must scatter. Every opposition must bow. Every darkness MUST FLEE. EVERY CHAIN must break. Are you ready? Stand to your feet wherever you are. Stand to your feet. IF YOU CAN PACE, PACE. If you can raise your hands, raise them. If you can lift your voice, lift it. This is not entertainment. This is engagement. This is not performance. This is warfare. I want you to open your mouth and begin to pray. Begin to speak. Begin to decree. Begin to declare. Say this with me. Father, I thank you for this moment. I thank you for this encounter. I thank you for the revelation you have released. I thank you for the word that has come forth. I position myself to receive everything you have for me. I open my heart. I open my spirit. I open my life. Let your power flow. Let your fire fall. Let your glory manifest in the name of Jesus. Now we begin. I call forth the fire of the Holy Ghost. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. I decree and declare [music and singing] let every adversary assigned against my destiny be scattered. Let every adversary assigned against my FAMILY BE SCATTERED. LET every adversary assigned against my marriage be scattered. Let every adversary assigned against MY FINANCES BE SCATTERED. LET EVERY ADVERSARY ASSIGNED AGAINST MY HEALTH BE SCATTERED. LET EVERY ADVERSARY ASSIGNED AGAINST MY MINISTRY BE SCATTERED. LET EVERY ADVERSARY ASSIGNED AGAINST MY CHILDREN BE SCATTERED. LET EVERY ADVERSARY ASSIGNED AGAINST MY FUTURE be scattered. I invoke the blood of Jesus. I invoke the name that is above every name. I invoke the finished work of Calvary. I SPEAK TO EVERY POWER THAT HAS POSITIONED ITSELF against my rising. You are too small for the God I serve. You are too weak for the blood that speaks for me. You are too insignificant for the angels that FIGHT FOR ME. SCATTER NOW. SCATTER NOW. SCATTER NOW. I speak to every coven where my name has been mentioned for evil, CATCH FIRE. I SPEAK TO EVERY ALTAR WHERE SACRIFICE has been offered against my life, be destroyed. I SPEAK TO EVERY CAULDRON WHERE MY DESTINY IS BEING COOKED, BE OVERTURNED. I SPEAK TO EVERY POT WHERE MY VIRTUES ARE BEING HELD, BREAK TO PIECES. I SPEAK TO EVERY MIRROR WHERE MY FACE IS BEING MONITORED, SHATTER NOW. FIRE OF THE HOLY GHOST, arise for my sake. Vindicate me, oh Lord, against those who fight against me. Psalm 35, verses 1 through 3. Plead my cause, oh Lord, with them that strive with me. Fight against them that fight against me. Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help. Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me. Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation. I declare this scripture over my life. Lord, plead my cause. FIGHT AGAINST THOSE WHO FIGHT AGAINST ME. TAKE HOLD OF SHIELD AND BUCKLER. STAND UP FOR MY HELP. DRAW OUT THE SPEAR. STOP THE WAY AGAINST those who persecute me. Say unto my soul, I am your salvation. Not fighting alone, Jehovah Saboath, the Lord of host, fights for me. The armies of heaven fight for me. The angelic host fight for me. Michael the archangel fights for me. The blood of Jesus fights for me. I release confusion into the camp of my enemies. Just as the Lord confused the Egyptians at the Red Sea, I [music] decree confusion into the camp of every enemy that has risen against me. Let them fight among themselves. Let them destroy each other. LET THEIR PLANS BACKFIRE. LET THEIR STRATEGIES COLLAPSE. LET THEIR CONSPIRACIES BE EXPOSED. I decree the judgment of God upon every altar that has been raised against me. [music] Wherever sacrifice has been made against my life, whether in the physical realm or in the spiritual realm, I command THE FIRE OF GOD to consume that altar. I command the angel of destruction to visit THAT ALTAR. I COMMAND THAT ALTAR to become a desolation. LET THE PRIEST OF THAT ALTAR BE SCATTERED. LET THE WORSHIPERS AT THAT ALTAR BE CONFOUNDED. LET THE POWER behind that altar be broken. I break myself free from every evil association, every soul tie that has given the enemy access to my life. I sever it now. Every covenant that was made on my behalf without my knowledge, I renounce it now. Every dedication that was performed over my life to idols and demons, I cancel it now. I belong to Jesus Christ. I am blood bought. I am blood washed. I AM COVERED BY THE BLOOD OF the lamb. I speak to my destiny, arise and shine. Isaiah 60:1-3, arise, shine for thy light is come and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee. For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth and gross darkness the people, but the Lord shall arise upon thee and his glory shall be seen upon thee and the Gentiles shall come to thy light and kings to the brightness of thy rising. My light has come. The glory of the Lord has risen upon me. Darkness cannot cover me. Gross darkness cannot engulf me. The Lord has arisen upon me. His glory shall be seen upon me. Nations shall come to my light. Kings shall come to the brightness of my rising. I am rising. I am rising. I am rising. Nothing shall keep me down. Nothing shall hold me back. Nothing shall limit me. Nothing shall stop me. I decree and declare, this is my season of rising. This is my season of emerging. This is my season of manifestation. This is my season of celebration. Every hand that has been pressing me down, BE PARALYZED. EVERY POWER THAT has been holding me back, RELEASE ME NOW. EVERY CHAIN THAT HAS been binding me, break now. Every cage that has BEEN CONTAINING ME, SHATTER NOW. I release the roar of the lion of the tribe of Judah over my life. The lion is roaring. The lion is fighting. The lion is defending. The lion is advancing. When the lion roars, all other beasts must flee. When the lion roars, DARKNESS MUST SCATTER. WHEN THE lion roars, demons must tremble. When the lion roars, WITCHCRAFT MUST DIE. ROAR, lion of Judah. ROAR OVER my family. Roar over my marriage. ROAR OVER MY FINANCES. ROAR OVER MY HEALTH. ROAR OVER MY DESTINY. Let the enemies hear the roar and flee. I am praying in the spirit now. Shabalakata. Maranatha. Shikalaba. Korabatasha. Melakita. Sorabalaka. FIRE. FIRE. FIRE. LET FIRE fall upon every demonic assignment. Let fire consume every satanic agenda. Let fire destroy every witchcraft operation. Let fire burn EVERY OCCULT PRACTICE. LET FIRE SCATTER EVERY GATHERING OF WICKEDNESS. I am coming against the spirit of delay. You spirit of delay, you have held me for too long. You have postponed my blessings for too long. You have delayed my breakthrough for too long, but your time is up. I BIND YOU. I CAST you out. I expel you from my life. I command you to release everything you have stolen from me. Release my time. Release my opportunities. Release my connections. Release my resources. Release my breakthroughs. I am coming against the spirit of stagnation. You spirit of stagnation, you have kept me in one place for too long. You have made me go in circles for too long. You have prevented my progress for too long, but I break free from your grip. I refuse to remain stagnant. I refuse to stay in one place. I am moving forward. I am advancing. I am progressing. I am growing. I am increasing. I am coming against the spirit of limitation. Receive this blessing before you go. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. May the presence of God go with you. May the power of God sustain you. May the protection of God cover you. May the provision of God satisfy you. May the purpose of God direct you. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in victory. The siege is over. Walk into your new season. Share this message with someone. Be a blessing to another. God bless you. Shalom.
